target_description.input_format: Arbitrary byte slices of any length (including empty)
assertions: Determinism: hash_bytes(data) called twice produces identical output
Output length is consistent (4 GoldilocksField elements)
All output elements are in canonical range [0, p)
target_description.critical_finding_criteria: Non-deterministic output or panic on any input

campaign_methodology.seed_corpus_source: Empty bytes, single byte, test input strings from existing test suite

campaign_results.notes: 60-second fuzzing campaign executed successfully. 102k executions at 1.7k exec/s with no crashes or panics. Hash determinism verified — hash_bytes(data) called twice always produced identical output. Output length consistently 4 GoldilocksField elements, all in canonical range [0, p). Corpus stabilized at 77 entries.
